items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
November 9, 2026

In recent months, artificial intelligence agents that can reason, plan and use external tools to accomplish multistep tasks have already reshaped computer coding, online shopping, dinner reservations and cyberattacks.

Robotics might be next. [...] OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge. [...] Goldberg, who was recently inducted into the National Academy of Engineering, is presenting the new approach and results from months of testing this week at the Conference on Robot Learning. He and his team are also releasing open-source code for other roboticists to experiment with, built on NVIDIA’s Isaac open simulation framework  for developers, as well as an industry-standard benchmark for evaluating the performance of robots across industrial tasks.

items.title: How are we all feeling about AI right now? – Deseret News
items.summary: Fast-emerging artificial intelligence tools and software are stoking plenty of concerns as an increasing number of AI-driven misdeeds are reported. And alongside those incidents, predictions are coming from some within the AI development world that the technology could advance to the point of threatening the whole of humanity. [...] Johns Hopkins University professor and AI researcher Christopher Honey reviewed the new polling data and, in a Deseret News interview, said he sees a notable convergence between the Deseret News poll’s findings on artificial intelligence and what he discovered in his own national polling — people want safeguards around AI, but they also hope the technology will deliver meaningful advances. [...] Faster medical research and new treatments; earlier, more accurate diagnosis of disease; and scientific discovery beyond health occupied the top spots for both polling samples. Both audiences also matched up in their next three AI hopefulness rankings of improving accessibility for people with disabilities; lowering the cost of goods and services; and taking over dangerous or repetitive work.

results.input: Giải giúp mình bài toán tích phân: nguyên hàm của x^2 là gì?

result.actual_text:
Nguyên hàm của hàm số $f(x) = x^2$ được tính theo công thức tính nguyên hàm của hàm lũy thừa:

$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

Trong đó $C$ là hằng số thực.

Mỹ, Iran bất đồng [...] Qun đội Ukraine tuyên bố đã phá hủy một cy cầu đường sắt chiến lược bắc qua kênh đào Bắc Crimea, tuyến hậu cần quan trọng phục vụ vận chuyển nhiên liệu, hàng hóa và thiết bị qun sự của Nga.

Tại eo biển Hormuz, Tehran cho biết các tàu thuyền phải đăng ký với một công ty bảo hiểm mới của Iran khi lưu thông qua khu vực, động thái được cho là có thể mở đường cho việc áp dụng các khoản phí dịch vụ trong tương lai. Tuy nhiên, Ngoại trưởng Mỹ Marco Rubio khẳng định không quốc gia nào có quyền thu phí đối với một tuyến hàng hải quốc tế.

OpenAI has closed on new funding of $11 billion, the initial part of a round that values the company at $1.25 trillion, according to people familiar with the matter.

Nov 6 (Reuters) - OpenAI has closed ‌on new funding of $11 billion, the initial part of a round ​that values the company ​at $1.25 trillion, a source familiar with ⁠the matter said on Friday.

The $11 ​billion raised so far represents ​only a portion of OpenAI's original target of up to $30 billion, while ​the company's valuation has ​come down from the $1.5 trillion level it ‌had ⁠initially sought, two investors said.
